votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of Tuesday, January 5, 2021; Tuesday, January 19, 2021; Tuesday, December 7, 2021; and Tuesday, December 14, 2021 as well as the formal meeting minutes of Tuesday, April 6, 2021; Tuesday, April 13, 2021; Tuesday, September 14, 2021; Tuesday, December 7, 2021; and Tuesday, December 14, 2021.
votes.description: The Council approved multiple prior work session and formal meeting minutes from 2021. This is a routine administrative action to officially adopt the official record of past meetings.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing to a future date and adopt partial final budget amendment for Ordinance 01 of 2022, amending the FY 2021-22 final budget including: A-1 Salt Lake County Police Services at Homeless Resource Centers Contract ($400,000 from Fund Balance), E-1 COVID-19 Local Assistance Matching Grant for the Switchpoint Hotel Project ($3 million from Misc. Grants), I-1 Council Office Reclassification and Amending FY22 Appointed Pay Plan (-0-), and I-2 CARES Act Unused Funds – Firefighter Personnel Expenses (Estimated at $47,000).
votes.description: The Council partially adopted Budget Amendment No. 5 for FY 2021-22, approving specific line items including police services funding at homeless shelters and a matching grant for transitional housing, while continuing the public hearing on the remaining items to a future date.

votes.motion: Elect Council Member Dugan to be the Chairperson and Council Member Mano to be the Vice Chairperson for 2022 calendar year.
votes.description: The Council ratified the election of its Chair and Vice Chair for calendar year 2022, selecting Daniel Dugan as Chair and Darin Mano as Vice Chair.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (Board Appointment: Bicycle Advisory Committee – Ashley Lodmell).
votes.description: The Council approved the appointment of Ashley Lodmell to the Bicycle Advisory Committee for a term ending January 4, 2025.
